summary: Braemar Hotels & Resorts filed an 8-K disclosing an October 6, 2026 Cooperation and Settlement Agreement with activist Al Shams Investments and Wafic Rida Said, ending a proxy fight. Al Shams withdrew its director nomination notice, accepted customary standstill and voting commitments, and gained consultation rights on one additional board seat, though the board retains sole selection discretion. Braemar will pay Al Shams $25 million plus expenses, offset by insurance and a 50/50 Allocation Agreement with Ashford; net Braemar cost is guided to $4-6 million. Watch insurance recovery and standstill expiry.
